rows.text: takes byte `rcx+3` shifted right by 5; when it is 1, stores `xmm1` as a float at `+0x68` of the qword at `rcx+0xb8` and writes byte `+0x5c` there as 1 when 0.0 is greater than `xmm1` (else 0); when it is 3, does the same at `+0xc8` and byte `+0xdd` of that qword; on every path, other values included, it tail-jumps to `00268380` with the incoming `rcx`

notes: 0026BA00: the comparison is comiss 0.0, xmm1 with seta, so an unordered (NaN) xmm1 gives 0. On the value-3 path rdx holds the qword at rcx+0xb8 at the tail jump; on the value-1 path rcx is restored from r8 and edx is 0; xmm1 is unchanged on all paths (not stated as arguments since the listing does not show 00268380 reading them).
